Method override support using pre-route advice. This avoids method-confusion by applying override before route lookup.Returns a MethodOverrideOptions with the standard header, query, and form sources, a 16KiB form limit, and PUT/PATCH/DELETE as allowed targets.Trims and upper-cases a raw override token, returning an empty string when it exceeds 15 characters or contains any non-alphabetic byte.Maps an upper-cased method token to a HttpMethod, rejecting CONNECT and TRACE as well as unknown method names.URL-decodes a single form key or value, translating + to a space first when plusAsSpace is set.Scans a urlencoded request body for fieldName without decoding the whole body, enforcing maxFormBytes via the content-length hint and actual size.Inspects the header, query, and form sources named in options and returns the MethodOverrideResolveResult for the first valid override token found.Rewrites req.methodKind for a resolved override and invokes auditHook; returns true only when the request method actually changed.Resolves and applies the first valid method override for req, returning whether the request method was changed.Registers a pre-route advice on app that applies method overrides and, when enabled, rejects invalid tokens with rejectStatus.Convenience alias.

  fromMethods*: set[HttpMethod]

MethodOverrideResolveKind = enum
  morkNone, morkInvalidToken, morkDisallowedTarget, morkResolved
MethodOverrideResolveResult = object

  source*: MethodOverrideSource

MethodOverrideSource = enum
  mosHeader, mosQuery, mosForm
